Package org.cibseven.bpm.quarkus.engine.extension.impl

Class QuarkusExecuteJobsRunnable

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.jobexecutor.ExecuteJobsRunnable
org.cibseven.bpm.quarkus.engine.extension.impl.QuarkusExecuteJobsRunnable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class QuarkusExecuteJobsRunnable extends ExecuteJobsRunnable
CIB7-1959 Quarkus job executor creates threads without the Quarkus TCCL (SRCFG00015)

An ExecuteJobsRunnable that runs jobs with the Quarkus class loader as thread context class loader, instead of the process engine's class loader.

ExecuteJobsRunnable.switchClassLoader() switches the TCCL to ProcessEngine.class.getClassLoader() so engine classes can be loaded during job execution (CAM-10379). Under Quarkus that switch is unnecessary - the Quarkus class loader already sees the engine classes - and it breaks configuration lookups: SmallRye Config resolves @ConfigProperty injection points by an exact identity match of the current TCCL against its registered class loaders, with no parent-class-loader fallback. When the engine class loader is not the very instance the Quarkus configuration was registered with, a CDI bean carrying @ConfigProperty that is lazily created from a job fails with SRCFG00015: No configuration is available for this class loader, which the engine reports as a failed job incident.

This mirrors JcaInflowExecuteJobsRunnable, which skips the switch for the same structural reason.
